_comment: Single source of truth for dsh-status-chime: the spoken line, the voice, and the synthesis settings.
Regenerate everything with: node scripts/build.mjs build
Then check it with:          node scripts/qa.mjs clips
Copy style: plain system-notice wording. Say what happened, briefly. No roleplay and no
filler. The failure lines are deliberately longer than the success lines so that the
severity can be judged by clip length alone when you are not looking at the screen.
Voice: a mature, composed female voice at a measured pace, delivered calmly rather than
performed. Only the voice carries character; the wording stays neutral.
_voiceNote: Set via scripts/build.mjs audition, then locked in here.
Run `node scripts/build.mjs voices` to list the candidates below, and
`bl speech synthesize --list-voices --model <model>` for the full catalogue.
_candidateNote: Starting points for an audition. Each entry may override instruction/rate/pitch.
Only the voices available for the chosen model can actually be used; check the
catalogue first, since the two model families expose different voices.

voiceCandidates.label: same voice, plainer style
voiceCandidates.instruction: A mature adult female voice with a low, resonant tone. Steady, moderately unhurried delivery, calm and matter-of-fact. Not girlish, not flat, and not performed.

voiceCandidates.label: warmer voice from the plus model family

instruction: A mature, composed adult female voice with a slightly hushed, close-mic quality. Steady delivery at a noticeably unhurried pace, phrases easing off gently at the end. Calm and self-assured. Not girlish, not exaggerated, and not flat or mechanical.
_consistencyNote: The clips shipped in assets/clips were generated with an equivalent style instruction.
TTS output is stochastic, so regenerating will not reproduce the shipped files byte for
byte even with identical settings; it lands in the same style range, nothing more.
